packMeta.name: GrillStack (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey burger shop command center: live order counter with Rush toggle, multi-station kitchen pass KDS (Grill, Fryer, Assembly, Drinks), menu & ingredient builds, prep & par stock, crew shifts with break tracking, and nightly till reconciliation. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
